The view takes labels back, results, challenge, solution, gallery, liveSite and services from site.labels, and the back link's address from site.collectionIndexes['case-study'] (the case studies' index). site.caseStudy is left out, so the featured image is in the flow, the default layout (case-study/aside draws the other). No case draws the header as a band (data-header band), which the markup describes only in a note.

document.title: Restoring the walled garden
document.summary: A derelict Victorian kitchen garden brought back into production for the farm shop and café.

results.label: varieties grown in the first year
of the café's vegetables grown on site

document.challenge: The walls were sound, but forty years of bramble and ash saplings had taken the beds, and the glasshouse had lost most of its glass.
document.solution:
We cleared the garden by hand to keep the old box edging, then laid out the beds again on the original plan.

Planting for the café

The planting follows the café's menu through the year, with salad and herbs nearest the kitchen door.
